teaser: The flickering sign at the gate reads final boarding, and you are still deciding which line to stand in. Life path 5 and INTP meet here, in the half-second before a choice: one system built around motion, the other around the question that never quite closes. A 5 wants the next door open; an INTP wants to understand the room before leaving it. This crossing produces someone who can talk themselves into three different departures before noon, each one reasoned, each one real for an hour. The particular shape of this crossing is less about where you go than about how convincingly you can argue for going.
